findings.evidence: `select_soonest_due` picks the nearest upcoming due date; contract §2 'Select the soonest-due discussion' describes this behavior.
`run()` builds a gate prompt naming title and due date before extraction; contract §2 'Confirmation gate ... naming the selected discussion and its due date' reflects it.
On declined confirm `run()` returns before `open_discussion`/`extract_prompt`; contract §2 'if the operator declines, the run aborts cleanly without extracting anything' reflects it.
On confirm `handoff.write_prompt` writes prompt.md to the run dir; contract §2 'Extract the prompt ... into the run dir (prompt.md)' reflects it.
`None` selection raises `NoUpcomingDiscussion`; contract §2 'If nothing is upcoming, the run stops and reports rather than guessing' reflects it.
`fill_reply` fills and never submits; contract §4 'fills the reply form and stops short of posting' reflects it.
`fill_reply` contains no submit/post-control lookup; contract §4 'No submit. No run path ever locates or clicks a submit/post control' reflects it.
`fill_reply` detects textarea-vs-contenteditable at runtime, fills, read-back-verifies, submits nothing; contract §4 'Runtime field-type detection' + 'Fill, then read-back verify' reflect it.
On `FillVerifyFailed`/`SelectorMiss` the caller preserves response.md and tells the operator to paste manually; contract §4 'On mismatch, abort and preserve' reflects it.
`browser.open_persistent_context` touches only the profile dir and stores no credential; contract §5 'No credentials persisted ... touches only the persistent profile directory' reflects it.
`ensure_logged_in` pauses and prompts for manual login while `is_login_page` holds; contract §6 'Post-navigation manual-login pause' reflects it.
Each step issues one navigation and raises on miss with no automated retry loop; contract §5 'Human pace, no retry-storm' reflects it.
All `*_SEL` selectors live only in portal_adapter.py and portal_parse imports their values; contract §7 'Every UOPX-specific selector ... live in one adapter module' reflects it.
`run()` writes response.md before calling `fill_reply`; contract §5/§8 'persist the response before fill' reflects it.
`main()` builds real deps and delegates to `run()` (the wired pipeline); contract §2 pipeline sequence + §9 Adapters describe that real entry-point wiring.
`validate()` drives each live step and gates each on a `confirm(...)` keypress; contract §6 'tool performs each live step and the operator confirms with a single keypress' reflects it.
`is_login_page`/`classify_landing` key on the pre-render ForgeRock shell markers, not a selector miss; contract §6 'Login classification from the pre-render shell' reflects it.

`_navigate_to_discussions` checks auth after the first navigation, pauses for manual login, and retries exactly once; contract §6 'Post-navigation manual-login pause with one retry. The auth check runs after the first portal navigation' reflects it.
